text: I really can't handle a drink.
note: Polite, a little nervous, apologetic, holding a cup he does not want. Say every word clearly.

text: It's in your head. One sip.
note: Easy, warm, teasing, sure he is right, holding the cup out to his friend.

text: I must say, this is a delightful gathering.
note: Suddenly very proper and posh, pleased with himself, like a gentleman at a garden party.

text: Good sir. Fetch me a carriage.
note: Grand old-fashioned aristocrat, haughty and slow, giving an order to a servant.

text: I shall duel the man who took my coat!
note: Outraged Victorian lord, loud and theatrical, pointing at the room.
Flat, calm, dry, after sniffing the cup, a tiny pause after Sami.
